build: DevEco Studio 26.0.0.851 debug signed, HarmonyOS API 26, ARM64

checks.mention_live: Passed against the packaged DSH: fuzzy file and folder references, canonical session URI, actual read tool context, referenced conversation history and persistent echo.
checks.regeneration_live: Passed against the packaged DSH: fork before the image-only prompt, preserve earlier history, upload original image to child, leave source reply unchanged.
checks.queued_attachments_live: Passed against the packaged DSH: restaging, stable request IDs, message order and matching attachment digest.
checks.speech_live: Packaged DSH correctly reports no speech service. Synthetic HTTP speech service verified catalog/configure/prepare/cancel/transcribe, WAV, authorization errors, unavailable endpoints, internal errors and cancellation.

acceptance_limits: No HDC device is connected; no installation, actual microphone/ASR, hardware IME, selection-menu, or same-viewport pixel comparison was performed.
CoreSpeechKit and AudioCapturer tests use API-shaped substitutes. Actual device capability, permission UI, audio sampling, long-clause event order and microphone release remain unverified.

The embedded runtime has no speech service. On-device SenseVoice download, verification, loading and removal are not implemented. Auto mode first uses the system unless the current on-device host reports ready sensevoice-local.
Rich clipboard text is normalized; clipboard images are not added as attachments. Use the existing photo/camera/file picker.
Media generation, voice scribe, reasoning translation and remaining roadmap groups are unfinished. This build is not a completed one-to-one acceptance.
